Hover to pause · Live data via Nextract API

One request. Structured data back.

Query Amazon or Flipkart.
Get clean, ready data.

Pass an ASIN, SKU, or keyword — receive structured product data instantly. No scraping, no proxies, no broken pipelines. Use it in your app, dashboard, or data workflow.

Full API reference 
# ASIN lookup — Buy Box + ratings
GET https://api.getnextract.com/v1/retail/product
    ?platform=amazon&asin=B0CM5JV8LP
Authorization: Bearer nxt_live_••••••••••••

── 200 OK ──────────────────────────────
{
  "asin":          "B0CM5JV8LP",
  "title":         "boAt Airdopes 141 TWS",
  "price":         899,
  "mrp":           3990,
  "discount_pct":  77,
  "rating":        4.1,
  "review_count":  218443,
  "in_stock":      true,
  "buy_box_seller":"Cloudtail India"
}
# Keyword search — Flipkart
GET https://api.getnextract.com/v1/retail/product
    ?platform=flipkart&q=samsung+s25+ultra
Authorization: Bearer nxt_live_••••••••••••

── 200 OK ──────────────────────────────
{
  "platform": "flipkart",
  "results": [{
    "id":       "MOBH3FGXJ5WQ",
    "name":     "Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 5G",
    "price":    129999,
    "mrp":      149999,
    "rating":   4.4,
    "in_stock": true
  }]
}

Why Nextract

Stop maintaining scrapers.
Start shipping products.

Every hour spent fixing broken parsers or babysitting bulk jobs is an hour not spent on your business.

Building it yourself
Marketplaces redesign HTML every few months — your parser breaks silently
Variant listings, bundles, and combos each need completely different handling
Anti-bot blocks hit production with zero warning
BSR and Buy Box are only reliable with fresh sessions and rotating proxies
Bulk ASIN lists need a parallel worker queue, retry logic, and result storage
Your engineer becomes the scraper maintainer — forever
vs
With Nextract
Stable, versioned schema — never breaks on your side regardless of marketplace changes
All product types handled and normalised to flat JSON every time
Managed proxy rotation and anti-bot infrastructure — zero CAPTCHA failures
Real BSR, Buy Box seller, and current pricing in every single response
Drop thousands of ASINs in one job — parallelism and retries all handled
Your engineers ship features, not scrapers
